meta.name: azure-quotas
meta.description: Check/manage Azure quotas and usage across providers. For deployment planning, capacity validation, region selection. WHEN: "check quotas", "service limits", "current usage", "request quota increase", "quota exceeded", "validate capacity", "regional availability", "provisioning limits", "vCPU limit", "how many vCPUs available in my subscription".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查和管理 Azure 配额与使用量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要管理 Azure 配额确保资源可用
copy.tagline_en: Check and manage Azure quotas and usage
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage Azure quotas to ensure resource availability

howto.what: Claude 会调用 Azure CLI 或随附脚本,查询订阅在各区域的服务配额上限、当前用量与剩余可用容量,列出某资源提供者(如计算、网络)的配额,还能对比不同区域并提交配额提升申请、查看审批状态。
howto.when: 当你说到“检查配额”“配额超限”“请求提高配额”等,或表达部署规划、区域容量验证、跨区域对比等需求时触发。

say.text: 查一下我的订阅在 eastus 的 vCPU 配额和用量。
帮我把 standardDSv3Family 的配额提高到 500。
say.note: 调用 az quota update 提交增加申请。

howto.what_en: Claude queries Azure quota limits, current usage and available capacity per region via the Azure CLI/scripts; lists quotas per provider, compares regions, and submits or tracks quota-increase requests.
howto.when_en: Triggered by phrases like “check quotas”, “quota exceeded” or “request quota increase”, or during deployment planning, region selection, capacity validation and quota troubleshooting.

say_en.text: Check my vCPU quota and usage in eastus for my subscription.
say_en.note: Returns limit, usage and available for cores etc.

say_en.text: Compare standardDSv3Family available capacity in eastus and westus2.
say_en.note: Loops regions and lists available numbers.
Calls az quota update to submit increase.
